issues.problem: ym-n5-days explain said 'In compounds 日 is にち', which mechanically misreads 日本 and 曜日/誕生日 (び).
issues.action: Changed to 'most compounds' and named 日本 にほん and び in 曜日, 誕生日.

issues.problem: ym-n5-days tip said dates one to ten end in か, but the 1st is ついたち.
issues.action: Added '(the 1st is ついたち)' to the tip.

issues.problem: ym-n5-size: the rule 'after a stretch of time 中 is じゅう' gives ごぜんじゅう for the common 午前中 (ごぜんちゅう).
issues.action: Added the 午前中 ごぜんちゅう exception to explain.

issues.problem: ym-n5-size: 上手 (in the skill title) has an irregular reading the guide did not cover.
issues.action: Added '上手 じょうず and 下手 へた are whole words' to explain.

issues.problem: ym-n5-time contrast label 'こん / こ / け' implied 今 has readings こ and け on their own, although 今年 and 今朝 are whole-word readings.
issues.action: Relabelled as 'こん / ことし / けさ (今)'.
